{"reason": "6 of 8 failure rows are false arbitrations with confidence 0.44-0.67; adding a high-confidence? gate removes them while the pct/exposure/frozen conditions are unchanged. Recall risk is bounded: recall only drops below the 0.8 gate if 2+ of the 8 true arbitrations have confidence < 0.7.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
